target_customer: Itself and outside investors whose capital it trades; it is a proprietary multi-strategy trading firm, not a software vendor
problem: Human trading pods are expensive to hire and slow to learn from outcomes. Spectre trains AI agents as traders and collects outcome data from each trade to improve them.
business_model: Proprietary trading firm earning trading returns, with a pod-shop structure of independent AI trading pods (semiconductors and biotech at launch)

founders.name: Michelle Li
education: Harvard, Economics and Biology, on leave
founders.background_notes: YC page says prior research on protein language models, bacteriophages and CRISPR Cas9, and lists her as an ISEF grand award winner and RSI and STS scholar. Company site says she has time spent trading and in prediction markets.

founders.name: Joshua Zyzak
education: Harvard, Computer Science and Electrical Engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page says he researched deep reinforcement learning controllers for quadruped robots and multimodal LLM robotics.

competitors.name: Standard Signal
competitors.what: YC Spring 2026 fund running autonomous AI traders and soliciting qualified investors with a $100,000 minimum

competitors.name: NickAI
competitors.what: Agentic trading operating system for retail traders across crypto, equities and prediction markets, launched March 2026
competitors.funding_then: described in coverage as backed by Galaxy Digital

technical_complexity.rationale: Building agents that make profitable trades under uncertainty and manage risk is hard, and the site claims an evolutionary agentic system, though the claim of profitability is unverified.

defensibility.rationale: The claimed advantage is outcome data collected from its own trades, but strategies and models are copyable and no track record is public.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to know as of the record date; Robinhood launched agentic trading for retail in 2026 but that is a different product.

market_need_then: Rising capability of AI agents and visible 2026 launches of agentic trading products suggest a technology shift; demand for outside capital in AI-run funds is untested per coverage of peers.

branding.domain_note: Uses spectreintelligence.ai, a prefix-and-suffix domain, no purchase info found

identity.logo: Not described by any source opened
identity.visual_style: Minimalist site with cellular automaton style tagline about square and diamond states in mirrored depth geometry
identity.voice_and_tone: Personal, conversational, humorous essay voice with biological metaphors such as evolution and carcinization

branding.brand_signature: Neotrading and neolab framing with biological evolution metaphors

brand_strength.rationale: Brand is days old and only the company's own site shows a voice; search shows confusion with unrelated Spectre.ai, a trading platform, and Spectre Divide, a shut game.

outcome_analysis: Spectre Intelligence is a Summer 2026 company with two founders and no public funding data, so no outcome exists yet. Its bet is that AI agents can replace human traders in a pod structure, and the main unknown is whether the claimed profitability holds and whether outside investors will supply capital as peers like Standard Signal also try.
notes: No funding amount found in the funding search or in the Extruct and directory listings. Site says the firm is already profitable, self reported and unverified. The unnamed co-founder on the company site is likely the CTO but the site does not name him. Searches for outcomes returned only unrelated Spectre companies.
